name: Claude Code instructions note
description: Adds the 'Questions (o-questions)' note to Claude Code's user instructions, between o-questions markers; the rest of the file is untouched.
content:
## Questions (o-questions)

Record and read questions only through mtm: the mtm MCP gateway (`run` with `questions.question ...`) or, without MCP, the mtm CLI (`mtm questions question ...`). Never put secrets in a question, answer, tag or link.

When the owner asks you a question (they want to know something, not to have something done), record it with `questions.question ask`, passing the owner's words exactly as typed. After you answer, record the answer with `questions.question answer` (the full answer, or a faithful summary with links to anything longer). Put a follow-up in the same thread with `questions.question follow-up` (or `ask` with `follow_up_of`). Record only questions from the owner's own messages, not from a brief another agent sent you.

When you need a decision from the owner, do not ask in chat when o-questions is available. Record it with `questions.question pose`, with your `recommendation` and a stable `key` so posing again keeps the decision. The owner answers on the Review page. Read decisions with `questions.question decisions`, answer the owner's asks with `questions.question reply`, and after acting on a decision record it with `questions.question applied`.
